package com.shopl.sdg.mcp.examples

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.ColumnScope
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import com.shopl.sdg.template.popup.center.SDGCenterPopup
import com.shopl.sdg.template.popup.center.SDGCenterPopupButtonOption
import com.shopl.sdg_common.foundation.SDGColor

/**
 * SDG - [MCP 예제] 실행 확인 Popup
 *
 * SDGCenterPopup 자체가 Dialog를 생성합니다. 확인 후 닫는 시점은 호출 화면에서 결정합니다.
 */
@Composable
fun ConfirmationExample(
    visible: Boolean,
    title: String,
    cancelLabel: String,
    confirmLabel: String,
    confirmEnabled: Boolean,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onConfirm: () -> Unit,
    body: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit,
) {
    if (visible) {
        SDGCenterPopup(
            title = title,
            buttonOption = SDGCenterPopupButtonOption.TwoOption(
                cancelLabel = cancelLabel,
                confirmLabel = confirmLabel,
                onClickCancel = onDismiss,
                onClickConfirm = onConfirm,
                onDismiss = onDismiss,
                cancelLabelColor = SDGColor.Neutral700,
                confirmLabelColor = SDGColor.Primary300,
                confirmEnabled = confirmEnabled,
            ),
            body = body,
        )
    }
}

package com.shopl.sdg.mcp.examples

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import com.shopl.sdg.component.button.box.SDGBoxButton
import com.shopl.sdg.component.button.box.SDGBoxButtonSize
import com.shopl.sdg.component.button.box.SDGBoxButtonType
import com.shopl.sdg.component.checkbox.SDGCheckBox
import com.shopl.sdg.component.checkbox.model.SDGCheckBoxSelectedBackgroundColor
import com.shopl.sdg.component.checkbox.model.SDGCheckBoxSize
import com.shopl.sdg.component.checkbox.model.SDGCheckBoxState
import com.shopl.sdg_common.foundation.SDGColor
import kotlinx.collections.immutable.PersistentList
import kotlinx.collections.immutable.PersistentSet

/** 선택 집합의 갱신과 적용 처리는 서로 다른 이벤트로 전달합니다. */
@Composable
fun MultiChoiceExample(
    optionIds: PersistentList<String>,
    selectedIds: PersistentSet<String>,
    applyLabel: String,
    applyEnabled: Boolean,
    onToggle: (String) -> Unit,
    onApply: () -> Unit,
    label: @Composable (String) -> Unit,
) {
    Column {
        optionIds.forEach { id ->
            Row {
                SDGCheckBox(
                    state = if (id in selectedIds) SDGCheckBoxState.SELECTED else SDGCheckBoxState.DEFAULT,
                    selectedBackgroundColor = SDGCheckBoxSelectedBackgroundColor.NORMAL,
                    size = SDGCheckBoxSize.MEDIUM,
                    onClick = { onToggle(id) },
                )
                label(id)
            }
        }
        SDGBoxButton(
            size = SDGBoxButtonSize.Medium,
            type = SDGBoxButtonType.Solid,
            label = applyLabel,
            labelColor = SDGColor.Neutral0,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Primary300,
            enable = applyEnabled,
            onClick = onApply,
        )
    }
}

/**
 * 기존 방식인 Single/Multiple/Period는 초기 선택값을 받고, 이후 날짜 선택은 달력 내부에서 관리한다.
 * 호출부에서 초기 선택값을 변경해도 달력의 선택 상태에는 반영되지 않는다.
 *
 * ExternalSelection은 날짜를 눌러도 선택 표시를 바로 변경하지 않고 onSelectDate로 알린다.
 * 호출부에서 선택값을 변경해 전달하면 달력의 선택 표시도 변경된다.
 */
sealed class SDGCalendarDayMode(
    open val inActivatedList: List<DateTime>?,
    open val disabledList: List<DateTime>?,
    open val bulletList: List<DateTime>?,
) {
    data class View(
        override val inActivatedList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val disabledList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val bulletList: List<DateTime>? = null,
    ) : SDGCalendarDayMode(inActivatedList, disabledList, bulletList)

    data class Single(
        val selected: DateTime? = null,
        override val inActivatedList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val disabledList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val bulletList: List<DateTime>? = null,
    ) : SDGCalendarDayMode(inActivatedList, disabledList, bulletList)

    data class Multiple(
        val selectedList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val inActivatedList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val disabledList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val bulletList: List<DateTime>? = null,
    ) : SDGCalendarDayMode(inActivatedList, disabledList, bulletList)

    data class Period(
        val selected: Pair<DateTime, DateTime>? = null,
        override val inActivatedList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val disabledList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val bulletList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        val maxCount: Int = 0,
        val fixedCount: Int = 0,
    ) : SDGCalendarDayMode(inActivatedList, disabledList, bulletList)

    /** 호출부의 단일 선택을 표시하며, null은 선택 없음이다. */
    data class SingleExternalSelection(
        val selected: DateTime? = null,
        override val inActivatedList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val disabledList: List<DateTime>? = null,
        override val bulletList: List<DateTime>? = null,

@Preview

private fun PreviewSDGSimpleTextInput() {
    Column(
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(10.dp)
    ) {
        var input by remember { mutableStateOf(TextFieldValue("")) }
        SDGSimpleTextInput(
            input = input,
            hint = "이름을 입력하세요",
            state = SDGSimpleTextInputState.Default,
            inputField = SDGSimpleTextInputField.White,
            style = SDGSimpleTextInputStyle.Outlined,
            onInputChange = { input = it },
        )


        val defaultDecimalFormat = DecimalFormat(
            "###,###.###",
        )
        var numberInput by remember { mutableStateOf(TextFieldValue("")) }
        SDGSimpleTextInput(
            input = numberInput,
            hint = "금액을 입력하세요(Default Decimal Format)",
            state = SDGSimpleTextInputState.Default,
            inputField = SDGSimpleTextInputField.White,
            style = SDGSimpleTextInputStyle.Outlined,
            decimalFormat = defaultDecimalFormat,
            maxValue = 100000.0,
            onInputChange = { numberInput = it },
            keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
        )
        SDGText(
            text = "Origin Value : ${numberInput.text}",
            textColor = SDGColor.Neutral700,
            typography = SDGTypography.Body3R
        )

        val indonesiaDecimalFormat = DecimalFormat(
            "###,###.###",
            DecimalFormatSymbols.getInstance(Locale("id", "ID"))
        )
        var indonesiaNumberInput by remember { mutableStateOf(TextFieldValue("")) }
        SDGSimpleTextInput(
            input = indonesiaNumberInput,
            hint = "금액을 입력하세요(Indonesia Decimal Format)",
            state = SDGSimpleTextInputState.Default,
            inputField = SDGSimpleTextInputField.White,
            style = SDGSimpleTextInputStyle.Outlined,
            decimalFormat = indonesiaDecimalFormat,
            maxValue = 100000.0,
            onInputChange = { indonesiaNumberInput = it },
            keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
        )
        SDGText(
            text = "Origin Value : ${indonesiaNumberInput.text}",
            textColor = SDGColor.Neutral700,
            typography = SDGTypography.Body3R
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ComponentContent(
    style: SDGBoxBadgeStyle,
    fontWeight: SDGBoxBadgeFontWeight,
    status: SDGSampleStatus,
) {
    val labelColor = when (style) {
        SDGBoxBadgeStyle.Solid -> SDGColor.Neutral0
        is SDGBoxBadgeStyle.Line -> style.lineColor
    }
    val backgroundColor = when (style) {
        SDGBoxBadgeStyle.Solid -> SDGColor.Primary300
        is SDGBoxBadgeStyle.Line -> SDGColor.Transparent
    }
    val onClick: (() -> Unit)? = if (status == SDGSampleStatus.DEFAULT) ({}) else null

    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(
                horizontal = SDGSpacing.Spacing16,
                vertical = SDGSpacing.Spacing40,
            ),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
        Column(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(SDGSpacing.Spacing16),
        ) {
            SDGBoxBadge(
                label = "Label",
                style = style,
                fontWeight = fontWeight,
                labelColor = labelColor,
                backgroundColor = backgroundColor,
                onClick = onClick,
            )
            SDGBoxBadge(
                label = "Left Icon",
                style = style,
                fontWeight = fontWeight,
                labelColor = labelColor,
                backgroundColor = backgroundColor,
                leftIc = SDGBoxBadgeIcon(
                    resId = R.drawable.ic_common_prev_s,
                    tint = labelColor,

                onClick = onClick,

            SDGBoxBadge(
                label = "Right Icon",
                style = style,
                fontWeight = fontWeight,
                labelColor = labelColor,
                backgroundColor = backgroundColor,
                rightIc = SDGBoxBadgeIcon(
                    resId = R.drawable.ic_common_next_s,
                    tint = labelColor,
                ),
                onClick = onClick,
            )
            SDGBoxBadge(
                label = "Label이 길어지면 가용 범위 내에서 말줄임표로 표시되는 최대 너비 Box Badge입니다.",
                style = style,
                fontWeight = fontWeight,
                labelColor = labelColor,
                backgroundColor = backgroundColor,
                isFillMaxWidth = true,
                marginValues = PaddingValues(horizontal = SDGSpacing.Spacing8),
                leftIc = SDGBoxBadgeIcon(
                    resId = R.drawable.ic_common_prev_s,
                    tint = labelColor,
                ),
                rightIc = SDGBoxBadgeIcon(
                    resId = R.drawable.ic_common_next_s,
                    tint = labelColor,
                ),
                onClick = onClick,
            )
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun BoxTabScreenContent() {
    val tabs = listOf(
        SDGBoxTabItem("근무지", SDGBoxTabItem.ShowTwoDepth.True("서울 본사", "1")),
        SDGBoxTabItem("구성원", SDGBoxTabItem.ShowTwoDepth.True("홍길동", "2")),
        SDGBoxTabItem("상태", SDGBoxTabItem.ShowTwoDepth.True("진행 중", "12")),
    )
    val twoTabs = tabs.take(2)

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .background(SDGColor.Neutral50)
            .padding(horizontal = SDGSpacing.Spacing16, vertical = SDGSpacing.Spacing24),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(SDGSpacing.Spacing24),
    ) {
        BoxTabSection(
            title = "2 Option · Solid",
            option = SDGBoxTabOption.TwoOption(twoTabs),
            style = SDGBoxTabStyle.Solid,
        )
        BoxTabSection(
            title = "2 Option · Line",
            option = SDGBoxTabOption.TwoOption(twoTabs),
            style = SDGBoxTabStyle.Line,
            initialSelectedTab = 1,
        )
        BoxTabSection(
            title = "3 Option · Solid",
            option = SDGBoxTabOption.ThreeOption(tabs),
            style = SDGBoxTabStyle.Solid,
            initialSelectedTab = 1,
        )
        BoxTabSection(
            title = "3 Option · Line",
            option = SDGBoxTabOption.ThreeOption(tabs),
            style = SDGBoxTabStyle.Line,
            initialSelectedTab = 2,
        )
        BoxTabSection(
            title = "2Depth 미노출",
            option = SDGBoxTabOption.TwoOption(
                twoTabs.map { it.copy(showTwoDepth = SDGBoxTabItem.ShowTwoDepth.False) },
            ),
            style = SDGBoxTabStyle.Solid,
        )
        BoxTabSection(
            title = "2Depth 표시 혼합",
            option = SDGBoxTabOption.ThreeOption(
                tabs.mapIndexed { index, tab ->
                    if (index == 1) tab.copy(showTwoDepth = SDGBoxTabItem.ShowTwoDepth.False) else tab
                },
            ),
            style = SDGBoxTabStyle.Line,
            initialSelectedTab = 1,
        )
        BoxTabSection(
            title = "긴 라벨 · 선택값 · Count 유지",
            option = SDGBoxTabOption.ThreeOption(
                tabs.map { tab ->
                    tab.copy(
                        label = "여러 줄에 걸쳐 표시되는 긴 탭 라벨",
                        showTwoDepth = SDGBoxTabItem.ShowTwoDepth.True("한 줄에서 말줄임 처리되는 매우 긴 선택값", "12"),
                    )
                },
            ),
            style = SDGBoxTabStyle.Solid,
        )
        BoxTabSection(
            title = "Count 없음 · 0 · 1 → 미노출",
            option = SDGBoxTabOption.ThreeOption(
                listOf(null, "0", "1").mapIndexed { index, count ->
                    tabs[index].copy(showTwoDepth = SDGBoxTabItem.ShowTwoDepth.True("선택값", count))
                },
            ),
            style = SDGBoxTabStyle.Line,
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ComponentContent(
    type: SDGBoxButtonType,
    size: SDGBoxButtonSize,
    status: SDGSampleStatus,
) {
    var clickCount by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    var selected by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val enabled = status != SDGSampleStatus.DISABLED
    val backgroundColor = if (type == SDGBoxButtonType.Solid) SDGColor.Neutral200 else SDGColor.Neutral0

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(
                horizontal = SDGSpacing.Spacing16,
                vertical = SDGSpacing.Spacing24,
            ),
        horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(SDGSpacing.Spacing12),
    ) {
        SDGText(
            text = "버튼 클릭: $clickCount",
            textColor = SDGColor.Neutral700,
            typography = SDGTypography.Body2R,
        )
        SDGBoxButtonIconSize.entries.forEach { iconSize ->
            SDGBoxButton(
                size = size,
                type = type,
                label = "Label (${iconSize.name})",
                labelColor = SDGColor.Neutral600,
                backgroundColor = backgroundColor,
                leftIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.True(
                    iconResId = R.drawable.ic_common_prev_s,
                    iconColor = SDGColor.Neutral600,
                    iconSize = iconSize,
                ),
                rightIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.True(
                    iconResId = R.drawable.ic_common_next_s,
                    iconColor = SDGColor.Neutral600,
                    iconSize = iconSize,
                ),
                onClick = { clickCount++ },
                enable = enabled,
            )
        }
        SDGBoxButton(
            size = size,
            type = type,
            label = "아이콘 없음",
            labelColor = SDGColor.Neutral600,
            backgroundColor = backgroundColor,
            leftIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.False,
            rightIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.False,
            onClick = { clickCount++ },
            enable = enabled,
        )
        SDGBoxButton(
            size = size,
            type = type,
            label = "긴 버튼명은 정해진 최대 너비에서 말줄임합니다",
            labelColor = SDGColor.Neutral600,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Transparent,
            leftIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.False,
            rightIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.True(
                iconResId = R.drawable.ic_common_next_s,
                iconColor = null,
                iconSize = SDGBoxButtonIconSize.S,
            ),
            onClick = { clickCount++ },
            enable = enabled,
            maxWidth = BoxButtonSampleMaxWidth,
        )
        SDGBoxButton(
            size = size,
            type = type,
            label = "흰색 라벨",
            labelColor = SDGColor.Neutral0,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Primary300,
            leftIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.True(
                iconResId = R.drawable.ic_common_prev_s,
                iconColor = SDGColor.Neutral0,
                iconSize = SDGBoxButtonIconSize.XS,
            ),
            rightIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.False,
            onClick = { clickCount++ },
            enable = enabled,
        )
        SDGBoxButton(
            size = size,
            type = type,
            label = if (selected) "선택됨" else "선택하기",
            labelColor = if (selected) SDGColor.Neutral900 else SDGColor.Neutral600,
            backgroundColor = if (selected) SDGColor.Neutral300 else backgroundColor,
            leftIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.False,
            rightIc = SDGBoxButtonShowIcon.False,
            onClick = {
                selected = !selected
                clickCount++
            },
            enable = enabled,
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun CategoryNaviContent(
    label: SDGCategoryNaviLabel,
    backIcon: SDGCategoryNaviLeftIconItem,
    rightIcons: PersistentList<SDGCategoryNaviIconItem>,
    hasDropdown: SDGCategoryNaviHasDropdown,
) {
    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(vertical = SDGSpacing.Spacing40),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(SDGSpacing.Spacing20),
    ) {
        SDGCategoryNavi(
            label = label,
            leftIcon = backIcon,
            rightIcons = rightIcons,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
            hasDropdown = hasDropdown,
        )
        SDGCategoryNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "뒤로가기 아이콘이 없는 경우"),
            leftIcon = null,
            rightIcons = persistentListOf(rightIcons[1]),
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
            hasDropdown = hasDropdown,
        )
        SDGCategoryNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "드롭다운이 없는 경우"),
            leftIcon = backIcon,
            rightIcons = persistentListOf(rightIcons[0], rightIcons[1]),
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
            hasDropdown = SDGCategoryNaviHasDropdown.False,
        )
        SDGCategoryNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "긴 화면 타이틀이 들어가는 경우 말줄임표시 확인 필요"),
            leftIcon = backIcon,
            rightIcons = rightIcons,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
            hasDropdown = hasDropdown,
        )
        SDGCategoryNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "우측 아이콘이 없는 긴 화면 타이틀이 들어가는 경우 말줄임표시 확인 필요"),
            leftIcon = backIcon,
            rightIcons = null,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
            hasDropdown = hasDropdown,
        )
        SDGCategoryNavi(
            label = label.copy(color = SDGColor.Neutral0),
            leftIcon = backIcon,
            rightIcons = rightIcons.map {
                it.copy(iconColor = SDGColor.Neutral0)
            }.toPersistentList(),
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Primary300,
            hasDropdown = hasDropdown,
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TextNaviContent(
    actionClickCount: Int,
    onClickBack: () -> Unit,
    onClickAction: () -> Unit,
) {
    val label = SDGTextNaviLabel.True(text = "화면 타이틀", textColor = SDGColor.Neutral900)
    val backButton = SDGTextNaviBackButton.True(onClick = onClickBack, iconColor = SDGColor.Neutral700)
    val showActionIcon = ShowActionIcon.True(
        iconResId = R.drawable.ic_common_plus,
        iconColor = null,
    )
    val actionLabel = SDGTextNaviActionItem.Label(text = "저장", textColor = SDGColor.Neutral700, onClick = onClickAction)

    Column(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(vertical = SDGSpacing.Spacing40),
        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(SDGSpacing.Spacing20),
    ) {
        SDGText(
            text = "Action 클릭: $actionClickCount",
            typography = SDGTypography.Body2R,
            textColor = SDGColor.Neutral700,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = SDGSpacing.Spacing16),
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = label,
            backButton = backButton,
            showActionIcon = showActionIcon,
            actionLabel = actionLabel,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "뒤로가기 아이콘이 없는 경우"),
            backButton = SDGTextNaviBackButton.False,
            showActionIcon = showActionIcon,
            actionLabel = actionLabel,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = SDGTextNaviLabel.False,
            backButton = backButton,
            showActionIcon = showActionIcon,
            actionLabel = actionLabel,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "아이콘 없이 라벨만 있는 Action"),
            backButton = backButton,
            showActionIcon = ShowActionIcon.False,
            actionLabel = actionLabel,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "긴 화면 타이틀이 들어가는 경우 말줄임표시 확인 필요"),
            backButton = backButton,
            showActionIcon = showActionIcon,
            actionLabel = actionLabel,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = label,
            backButton = backButton,
            showActionIcon = showActionIcon,
            actionLabel = actionLabel.copy(text = "변경사항 저장하기"),
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Neutral100,
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "파란 배경", textColor = SDGColor.Neutral0),
            backButton = backButton.copy(iconColor = SDGColor.Neutral0),
            showActionIcon = showActionIcon.copy(iconColor = SDGColor.Neutral0),
            actionLabel = actionLabel.copy(textColor = SDGColor.Neutral0),
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Primary300,
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "분홍 배경"),
            backButton = backButton,
            showActionIcon = showActionIcon,
            actionLabel = actionLabel,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Red300_a10,
        )
        SDGTextNavi(
            label = label.copy(text = "투명 배경"),
            backButton = backButton,
            showActionIcon = showActionIcon,
            actionLabel = actionLabel,
            backgroundColor = SDGColor.Transparent,
        )
    }
}
